text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Manuel Monteiro quits as leader of the rightwing opposition Popular Party (PP). "Monteiro departs and leaves the PP adrift," banner headline says. Monteiro challenges former newspaper editor Paulo Portas to stand for the leadership at an extraordinary congress.
- Debts by Portuguese speaking countries to Portugal totalled 367.2 billion escudos in 1995. Angola is the biggest debtor.
- The Portuguese state will rake in between 31 and 36 billion escudos in the privatisation of a 65 percent stake of cigarette manufacturer Tabaqueira.
- "PP without bosses," runs banner headline. Monteiro said his decision to quit the PP leadership was the only way not to harm the party.
- Centre-right Social Democratic Party (PSD) to adopt similar line to ruling Socialist Party (PS) in tomorrow's debate about Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) in parliament.
- State oil company Petrogal boosts natural gas activities.
